what: channel art (banner, avatar) for Huge To Scale

assets.license: own work: simplified models built from primitives in Blender, no third-party meshes, no logos

sizes_note: Commonly published figures, used for the channel art only. Every Short gets its own check: Wikidata + a second official source, stopped if they differ by more than 2 %. The model heights match these figures within 1 % (scene.py self-check, printed as SIZE lines).
not_used: no AI imagery, no photos, no Christ the Redeemer, no night lighting of the Eiffel Tower, no NASA or other logos
